relationships.subject: DNMT1
relationships.evidence_quote: our findings suggest that DNMT1 may suppress the GABAergic projections from the CeA to LC-NAergic neurons

relationships.subject: LC noradrenergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of LC-NAergic neurons induced depression-like behaviors

relationships.subject: CeA GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunohistochemical staining and electrophysiological recordings confirmed the functional synaptic connection between CeA-GABAergic neurons and LC-NAergic neurons.

key_findings: LC is a major downstream target of CeA; CeA GABAergic neurons form functional synapses onto LC noradrenergic neurons.
Activation of LC-NA neurons induces depression-like behavior; inhibition improves SNI-induced depression-like behavior.
DNMT1 knockdown improves pain-related depression in a CeA-GABA to LC-NA circuit-dependent manner; DNMT1 may suppress this inhibitory projection.
